hook: A Raman-coupled potassium gas in a 1D lattice should behave as anyons, simulations show
hook_turn: should behave as anyons, simulations show
summary: The authors propose a lattice model, the Raman anyon-Hubbard model, in which laser-dressed bosons pick up phases that depend on neighboring occupation. Numerical calculations show the signatures of 1D anyons: lopsided momentum distributions, one-way-biased transport and chiral bound states. They argue 39K atoms could test it. Everything is simulation so far, with no experiment.
title: Raman anyon-Hubbard model in a 1D Bose lattice gas
